description.en: These frames show the robot close to the doorway and green artwork; pale flooring and indoor furniture are visible beyond the doorway, but there is no evidence that it had passed through, entered the bedroom, or stopped next to the bed or bedside table.

semantic_progress.en: As of S03: the robot has entered and moved along the hallway consistent with the established spatial relationships, with the green-framed artwork on the left, framed artworks visible on the right wall, and the doorway straight ahead being approached; an open area with a window, table, and chairs appeared ahead-left, but the tall potted plant and the open kitchen on the right described by the task have not been confirmed. It has not passed through the doorway into the bedroom, nor reached the bed or bedside table.

segment_summary.zh: 机器人继续沿走廊向正前方门洞前进：绿色边框画位于左侧，右侧墙面可见框画；左前方出现带窗、桌子和椅子的开放区域，未看到高盆栽。到 B 时已接近门洞但尚未穿过，未进入卧室或到达床边。
segment_summary.en: The robot continued along the hallway toward the doorway straight ahead: the green-framed artwork was on the left and framed artworks were visible on the right wall; an open area with a window, table, and chair appeared ahead-left, with no tall potted plant seen. At B it had approached but not yet passed through the doorway, and had not entered the bedroom or reached the bed.

reason.zh: 本段视角持续推进，门洞位于前方，绿色画在左、右侧框画的关系与已建立的走廊一致；但高盆栽、右侧开放式厨房以及左侧开放区域的用途未获确认，且尚无穿门或到达床边的证据。没有明确的通行冲突，故判为一致。
reason.en: The view advanced along the hallway with the doorway ahead, and the relationship of the green artwork on the left and framed artworks on the right is consistent with the established hallway; however, the tall potted plant, the open kitchen on the right, and the purpose of the open area on the left remain unconfirmed, and there is no evidence of passing through the doorway or reaching the bed. There is no clear transit conflict, so it is judged consistent.

instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 穿过正前方的门洞进入卧室。

instruction_evidence.quote_en: Walk towards the bed on your left, and stop next to the bedside table on the right side of the bed.
instruction_evidence.quote_zh: 朝你左侧的床走去，并在床右侧的床头柜旁停下。
